mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(T.TEACHER_NO) AS TEACHER_NO, T.PERSON_ID, T.EMPID, T.TEACHER_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME, T.TEACH_FIELD_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_FIELD_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_FIELD_CODE_NAME, T.TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_LEVEL_CODE_NAME, T.TEACH_STATUS_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_STATUS_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_STATUS_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(T.HIRE_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS HIRE_TIME, TO_CHAR(T.FIRING_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS FIRING_TIME, TO_NUMBER(T.BUSINESS_ACT_TIME) AS BUSINESS_ACT_TIME, ROUND(NVL(SYSDATE - T.HIRE_TIME, 0) / 30 + NVL(TO_NUMBER(T.BUSINESS_ACT_TIME), 0)) AS ALL_TIME, T.REMARK FROM EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER T LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID
mapper.select: WHERE T.TEACHER_NO = #{teacherNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER (TEACHER_NO, TEACH_FIELD_CODE, TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, HIRE_TIME, FIRING_TIME, TEACH_STATUS_CODE, BUSINESS_ACT_TIME, REMARK, EMPID, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, PERSON_ID, TEACHER_NAME) VALUES (#{teacherNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{teachFieldCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teachLevelCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{hireTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{firingTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{teachStatusCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessActTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teacherName, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER SET TEACH_FIELD_CODE = #{teachFieldCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACH_LEVEL_CODE = #{teachLevelCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HIRE_TIME = TO_DATE(#{hireTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), FIRING_TIME = TO_DATE(#{firingTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TEACH_STATUS_CODE = #{teachStatusCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TEACHER_NO = #{teacherNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
